provenance.what: Themis's own machine-readable transcription of the public SVCv4 pilot specification: the code names, point values, thresholds, matrix multipliers and routing an implementation needs. It carries none of the supplement texts.
provenance.verified_against: the supplements, at the line each value's citation names, and the ClinGen pilot calculator's cap tables via tools/svcv4-oracle, where every departure from the calculator is pinned with the passage behind it.
provenance.citation_form: SM<n> §<m> is line <m> of that supplement's text extraction under svcv4-docs/code-specific-workflow-guidance/txt/ in the repository meta.cited_documents pins; a decision-tree citation names a transcription under svcv4-docs/workflow-images/ there.

cited_documents.note: The revision every SM<n> §<m> and decision-tree citation in this file resolves against. The text extractions and workflow transcriptions are line-addressed, so a citation names one line only under a fixed tree.

meta.usage: Evaluation only. Not a validated implementation, not for clinical or diagnostic use; output is not a clinical variant classification. Re-verify every value against the final published standard and the ClinGen Pilot Calculator (https://calculator.clinicalgenome.org/v4/pilot/ui/classification).

odds_path_calibration.notes: v4 uses a continuous point scale rather than discrete strength buckets. Benign boundary set at 1% posterior probability (v3 Bayesian assumed 0.1%).

levels.result: Variant in Gene of Uncertain Significance

gene_disease_validity_gate.note: Also required (SM18) for molecular-mechanism scoring to be > "Uncertain": gene-disease validity must be Moderate or higher.

code_abbreviations.CDS: coding DNA sequence (i.e., not NUL / not NMD path)

concepts.PRD: In-silico / predictive evidence (initial point value, may be scaled by mechanism x exon matrix)
concepts.INF: Informative-variant evidence (other classified variants at/near the locus)
concepts.SPA: Splice-assay (RNA) evidence, specific to splice codes

dropped.PM1: dropped for missense (predictors now reach +4.0); retained narrowly (e.g. collagen Gly-X-Y glycine). See SM6/SM7.

POP_FRQ.input: FAF (grpmax filtering allele frequency, lower bound 95% CI)
caveats: beware low allele-number distortions (e.g. lcr flag)

calculator.preferred_when: no curated VCEP or community threshold exists for the MDE, and the analyst can estimate prevalence, penetrance, and locus and allelic heterogeneity
calculator.guidance: err toward high DAFT (conservative for benign calls)

binning.prevalence_rule: select the more common bin where the estimate falls between two, i.e. round the prevalence up: an estimated 1/2,000 takes the 1/1,000 bin. Estimate the phenotype prevalence lumping together every gene associated with the MDE (locus homogeneity assumed), and only over forms sharing its inheritance pattern.
binning.penetrance_rule: use the lower bin near a boundary, i.e. round the penetrance estimate down to a column
binning.penetrance_column_note: the images head their columns 80%, 50%, 20% over the instruction 'round down - i.e., disease is less penetrant', so a column is 'penetrance at least this value'. SM3's prose bins ('20% to <50%, 50% to <80% and >80%') leave 80% itself in no bin; the column labels govern.
binning.marker_note: the '*' printed on three cells of Tables 2 and 5 is defined nowhere in SM3: no footnote or endnote stream, no legend inside either image, no mention in the text. Every marked cell holds 0.05000, the largest value in either table.
binning.no_table_for: a combined-sex frequency in an X-linked-recessive MDE: SM3 prints no such table, so that observation has no binned route

provenance.read_from: the PNGs embedded in "Supplementary Material 3. Population Database Frequency.docx" (word/media). The six tables exist in SM3 only as images and appear in no text extraction of it.
provenance.table_to_image: taken from the r:embed order in word/document.xml, where each caption precedes its image; the media filenames do not follow caption order
provenance.read_at: 1500 px wide renders (1.3x native); Tables 2 and 6, whose digits follow no arithmetic pattern that would catch a misread, re-read at 2x on cropped row bands
provenance.completeness: all 144 cells in frame and legible; no cell empty, none unreadable

requires: age-matched penetrance of the MDE near 100%
affected individuals not expected to be present in population databases (a mild phenotype does not qualify)
POP_HMZ.excludes: unaffected individuals whose clinical details are given: those are CLN_UAF, not POP_HMZ

pop_frq_precondition.source: SM4 §25, which admits Tables 1 and 2 only at those two POP_FRQ point thresholds

CLN_CCS.effect_when_applied: all other CLN codes = NA except CLN_DNV

row_applicability.CONSISTENT: monoallelic or biallelic; a biallelic proband takes this row, Table 2 having one consistency category (SM4 §140)

locus_evidence.combined_cap: LOC total capped at +4.0 (below the +6.0 LP threshold by design)

LOC_PHE.ultra_rare_disorders: prevalence < 1/1,000,000: up to +2.0 from phenotype semantic-similarity algorithms
LOC_PHE.proband_rule: use single most specifically-phenotyped proband; biallelic compound-het applies to both variants; homozygote applies to the single variant

per_cosegregation.provenance: SM5 Figure 2, which exists in the supplement only as an image; read from the transcription svcv4-docs/code-specific-workflow-guidance/tables/SM5-segregation-points.md, its affected rows (:59-:71), at the revision meta.cited_documents pins. Its unaffected rows are per_unaffected, not here.

LOC_SEG.per_unaffected: up to +1.0 (AR: +0.4 per unaffected VBC carrier, SM5 §28, which scopes the award to carriers where SM5 Figure 2's AR row reads 'heterozygous or wild type'); only if penetrance ~100% and phase established

non_segregation.effect: zeroes LOC_PHE and LOC_SEG (log-odds -inf at Theta=0)
non_segregation.benign_points: -4.0 for AD / AR-homozygous / X-linked (legacy BS4); then re-analyze other loci excluding recombinant locus
non_segregation.AR_note: AR non-segregation gives NO benignity evidence

informative_variants.applied: AFTER mechanism_exon_matrix; NOT reduced by it
informative_variants.distinctness: must be DISTINCT from the VBC (identical variants -> CLN_AFF)
informative_variants.counting: count distinct variants only; observation count irrelevant
informative_variants.default_pathogenic_scoring: +2.0 first distinct P; +1.0 each additional P; if only LP: +1.0 first LP and +1.0 each additional
prerequisites: informative variant must itself be classified under v4 (do not take ClinVar P/LP at face value unless 3-4 star and circularity excluded; no PP5/BP6 shortcut)
do NOT award INF when the informative variant carries the SAME codes/weights as the VBC (e.g. both nonsense with only NUL_PRD_+6) - inflates points
informative_variants.mde_scope: limit to VBC's MDE; allelic MDEs sharing LoF mechanism qualify; paralogous-gene variants may contribute modest expert-judgment evidence

functional_assays.method: Brnich et al. OddsPath/likelihood-ratio (PMID 31892348; Tavtigian PMID 29300386)
functional_assays.requires: BOTH pathogenic AND benign controls (single WT reference insufficient)
functional_assays.strength_driver: # benign controls drives pathogenic strength (SM20 Table 1); # pathogenic controls drives benign strength (SM20 Table 2)

control_count_lookup.scope: small experiments with NO false positives and NO false negatives, after SM20's two prior gates (functional data exist, and the assay is faithful to the MDE's mechanism). Larger experiments, trichotomised readouts and MAVEs are calibrated mathematically instead (SM20 §22)
control_count_lookup.reading: Table 1 scores a test variant whose result falls in the PATHOGENIC control range, Table 2 one in the BENIGN control range. SM20 §22 cites them by the wrong numbers (its "Table 2" and "Table 3" are these Tables 1 and 2), and following the citation as written selects the wrong sign of evidence
control_count_lookup.maximum: neither grid reaches ±4.0: the small-experiment regime tops out at ±3.0 with ten controls of both kinds, and an assay needing Strong-level weight takes the mathematical route instead
control_count_lookup.single_control_note: one benign control is worth nothing for pathogenicity and one pathogenic control nothing for benignity: SM20 §22 holds that a single reference version of the protein does not meet the control standard, and the grids state it only through those all-zero lines

animal_models.knock_in_table: high phenotype replication + same inheritance + high protein similarity = +4.0; different inheritance = +3.0; key features same/different = +2.0/+1.0; similar phenotype = +1.0; low consistency/similarity = 0.0

functional_assays.patient_derived_samples: usually routed to LOC_PHE, not FXN (narrow exceptions)

exon_dup_insertion.diagram: Single Or Multiexon Dup Gain Workflow

routing_rules: > 1 gene affected -> CNV framework (PMID 31690835), not these trees
single exon-intron boundary deletion -> Canonical Splice (SM11)
NMD predicted when PTC >= 50 bp upstream of the last exon-exon junction (never in single-exon genes)

POP_HMZ.notes: per-observation -1.0 (AD hom) or -0.5, summed; from 2nd occurrence; requires age-matched penetrance near 100% and affected individuals not expected in population databases (SM3 Table 7)

CLN_CCS.notes: PS4 case-control -> benign AND pathogenic; OR>5 -> +4.0 (SM4 §23); disables other CLN except CLN_DNV. SM4 §13 states a benign direction with no magnitude, so the range is the ClinGen pilot calculator's EVIDENCE_CODE_CAP, the only executable statement of one; tools/svcv4-oracle holds both sides to it.

CLN_AFF.notes: mono Table1 (+0..+1 per proband); biallelic Table2 (up to +3.0); summed

CLN_DNV.notes: specific+confirmed=+7.0 per proband, summed across probands; SM4 states no cross-proband cap, so the upper side is the sum sentinel; additive with CLN_AFF; only the SPECIFIC row is monoallelic-only

CLN_ALT.notes: not for AR; -0.5/-1.0 per proband (SM4 Table 4), summed

CLN_UAF.notes: requires age-matched penetrance; points per unaffected individual (SM4 Table 5), summed

LOC_PHE.notes: diagnostic-yield bins; LOC_PHE + LOC_SEG capped JOINTLY at +4.0 (SM5 §5), which no per-code range can state

LOC_SEG.notes: +per affected/unaffected; non-seg -> -4.0 (AD/ARhom/XL); LOC_PHE + LOC_SEG capped JOINTLY at +4.0 (SM5 §5), which no per-code range can state. Range [-4,4] kept intentionally: the ClinGen pilot calculator clamps the benign floor to 0 ([0,4]), which drops SM5's non-segregation -4.0; ours is more correct (flag for spec confirmation).

MIS_PRD.notes: ONE calibrated predictor chosen in advance (BayesDel/MutPred2/REVEL/VEST4/AlphaMissense/ESM1b/VARITY_R); positive PRD scaled by transcript relevance All=x1/Most=x0.5/Few=x0

NUL_PRD.notes: NMD/loss-of-transcript path; initial +6.0 (+4.0 NSD), scaled by mechanism_exon_matrix. Code cap [0,6], the union of the subgenic ceilings SM8/SM9/SM15 state; the whole-gene-deletion +10.0 tier is admitted by the NUL_PFD category cap [-8,10] in cap_hierarchy, not by this code.

NUL_INF.notes: same-exon NMD PTC variants +2.0 first P/+1.0 LP/+1.0 additional

CDS_PRD.notes: coding/rescue path; by protein-fraction/critical-domain; -1.0 if functional alt-start

CDS_INF.notes: PTC downstream of VBC / between VBC and alt-start, per path

SPL_PRD.notes: initial by splice prediction; canonical NMD +6.0, intronic/synon NMD +3.0

SPL_SPA.notes: RNA splice assay; scales PRD in path, or standalone -2.0..+2.0 in uncertain path. Range is the union of the per-colour bounds: 0.0 to +3.0 (SM6 §69, SM12 §42), -2.0 to +2.0 (SM6 §98, SM11 §72), -2.0 to 0.0 (SM6 §119, SM11 §94, SM12 §109), and the -6.0 floor stated only in SM11's figure boxes (Canonical Splice Workflow.decision-tree.md:112 and :143). Nothing scores against the union: builders validate against splice_tree.spa_bounds, which derives the bound of the colour in play.

missense_MIS_INF_subrules.points: +4.0 first P; +2.0 LP or each additional

missense_MIS_INF_subrules.rule: distinct amino-acid change, P/LP, with Grantham distance < VBC
distinct amino-acid change, B/LB, with Grantham distance > VBC
critical-residue motif (collagen Gly-X-Y glycine; C2H2 Cys/His)
missense_MIS_INF_subrules.points: +2.0 once, only when no other P/LP informative variant; voided by any benign informative variant

critical_amino_acids.effect: up to +2.0 on top of predictor points for well-established critical individual residues (SM7 §5)
constraints: conserved domain membership alone earns NO points
immunoglobulin-like / duplicated-redundant domains generally do not qualify
only add if combined PRD_+INF_ maximum not yet reached (avoid double-counting; PP3+PM1 overlap)

multiple_disorder_policy.action: aggregate mono/biallelic evidence; classify the one MDE

multiple_disorder_policy.scenario: two MDEs, distinct inheritance but consistent mechanism
multiple_disorder_policy.action: aggregate; same final class for both
aggregate; case-count thresholds scale with phenotype specificity
do NOT aggregate; classify P only for the relevant MDE; benign/LB only if relevant to ALL MDEs; VUS toward MDE with partial evidence
do NOT aggregate; classify each MDE separately; note lack of evidence for others (avoid ClinVar conflicts)
judgment; aggregate only if phenotypes close and mechanism similar
aggregate all diseases into a list; note genes with unknown MDE associations

provenance.what: the concept-level and category-level combining caps above the per-code caps in evidence_codes, and which codes each parent code sums
provenance.concept_caps: stated: LOC SM5 §34 (the joint LOC_PHE + LOC_SEG cap, SM5 §5); MIS SM6 §19; MIS_INF SM6 §29; CDS SM8 §34; CDS_INF SM8 §38; NUL SM8 §13; NUL_INF SM8 §17; SPL and SPL_FXN SM11 §25; SPL_INF SM11 §27. SPL_PRD_SPA is stated once per colour, not once: +6.0 is SM12 §42's ceiling and -3.0 the widest of the four floors (SM6 §48 and §69 0.0, SM12 §42 -1.0, SM6 §98 -2.0, SM6 §119 / SM11 §94 / SM12 §109 -3.0). Implied, not stated: POP's 0.0 ceiling, since SM3 §2 and §72 make both POP codes benign-only; CLN's unbounded pair, since SM4 §77 and §143 sum per observation under no stated bound.
provenance.category_caps: the parent code each supplement caps the total at: MIS_PFD SM6 §31; CDS_PFD SM8 §38; NUL_PFD SM8 §23; SPL_PFD SM11 §31
provenance.concept_to_codes: where each summed code is introduced: MIS SM6 §15/§19/§29; CDS SM8 §32/§34/§38; NUL SM8 §11/§13/§17; SPL SM11 §17/§19/§25/§27
